correction: A coarse GRAPH or PROVEN_ZERO_EXISTS proof leaf guarantees surface structure/existence somewhere in that leaf; it does not imply every descendant d13 block intersects the surface. V1 incorrectly named every descendant block PROVEN_SURFACE. V2 moves completeness audits to proof-leaf scope.
subject_scope: same frozen 12 corrected C1-primary Knight d8 roots; local research only

planner_classes.CERTIFIED_EMPTY: terminal corrected-C0 strict-sign proof; all descendant target blocks may be pruned without querying
planner_classes.ACTIVE_GRAPH: terminal axis-graph proof leaf; all descendant blocks remain query-active, but graph completeness is audited at proof-leaf/axis-line scope
planner_classes.ACTIVE_ZERO_EXISTS: terminal C0 PROVEN_ZERO_EXISTS leaf without graph closure; all descendants remain query-active and the leaf must contain at least one d13 mixed-sign cube or target depth is insufficient
planner_classes.ACTIVE_UNKNOWN: terminal C0 UNKNOWN leaf; all descendants remain query-active and same-sign target corners never upgrade it to empty

graph_leaf_audit: For a GRAPH leaf, use its certified selected axis. On the aligned d13 lattice, every transverse lattice line spanning the leaf must contain at least one adjacent opposite-sign sample pair. Exact-zero target corners fail closed. This follows the graph certificate's opposite-sign entry/exit faces and strict directional regularity.
zero_exists_leaf_audit: Each ACTIVE_ZERO_EXISTS proof leaf must contain at least one mixed-sign d13 cube. Absence is a target-sampling incompleteness alarm, not a proof contradiction.
mesh_audit: Extract all mixed-sign cubes inside all non-empty proof leaves with blockwise Lewiner MC and require canonical sampled-lattice equivalence to dense d13 Lewiner MC on each root.
claim_boundary: X3 V2 does not run a full Knight witness and does not claim source-raster fidelity. It tests whether the proof partition can safely drive the existing MC contourer on a fixed local d13 lattice.
